fact_text: Fauji Cement says its new Dera Ghazi Khan plant takes total capacity to 10.6 million tons a year.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Fauji Cement strikes whilst expansion update at PSX: Market Update.' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)

fact_text: The new Dera Ghazi Khan plant came online commercially, with a notice to the PSX that the analysts had been waiting for over a year.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Fauji Cement strikes whilst expansion update at PSX: Market Update.' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)

fact_text: In 2016 a silo fell onto the new expansion plant, and the company recovered only partly from that setback.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Fauji Cement strikes whilst expansion update at PSX: Market Update.' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)

fact_text: Fauji Cement's retention price is above Rs 800 per bag, which the analyst said supports the second-quarter and half-year results.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Fauji Cement strikes whilst expansion update at PSX: Market Update.' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)

fact_text: Fauji Cement may announce a token dividend when the half year closes on 31 December 2023, since it used to pay dividends twice a year.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Fauji Cement strikes whilst expansion update at PSX: Market Update.' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)

fact_text: The analyst expects the new plant's benefit to show in FY25, which starts in July 2024.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Fauji Cement strikes whilst expansion update at PSX: Market Update.' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)

fact_text: The Dera Ghazi Khan site sits on motorways near Fateh Jang, Taxila and the growing Islamabad area, and hydropower projects in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa add demand.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Fauji Cement strikes whilst expansion update at PSX: Market Update.' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)

fact_text: The analyst said the capacity additions could bring Fauji Cement back to the 2009 to 2012 period, when it was investors' favourite.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Fauji Cement strikes whilst expansion update at PSX: Market Update.' (YouTube, 2023-12-05)
